returns._0: The pending balance in token base units.

params.feeRecipient_: Address that accrues fees and can withdraw them.
params.usdc_: ERC-20 payment token; use Arc Testnet USDC for the intended deployment.

params.bps: Positive shares in basis points, summing to exactly 10,000.
params.recipients: Between 1 and 10 distinct, nonzero recipient addresses.

returns.version: The current split version, starting at 1 and incremented on each update.

pay(uint256,uint256,uint32,bytes32).details: No funds are pushed to recipients. Floor-rounded dust goes to recipient zero.      Exact receipt is enforced so underfunded transfers cannot create liabilities.

params.amount: Positive payment amount in the token's smallest units.
params.expectedVersion: The split version the payer authorizes; must match the current version.
params.paymentReference: Arbitrary payer-supplied reference, recorded in the event.
params.splitId: An existing split, regardless of who owns it.

params.bps: The replacement shares, summing to exactly 10,000.
params.splitId: An existing split owned by the caller.

withdraw(address).details: Checks-effects-interactions and a shared reentrancy guard protect withdrawals.

params.to: Nonzero destination for the caller's tokens.

FEE_BPS().notice: Fixed protocol fee of 20 basis points (0.2%).

balanceOf(address).notice: Return an account's pending, withdrawable token balance, including any fees.

createSplit(address[],uint16[]).notice: Create a split owned permanently by the caller.

feeRecipient().notice: The address credited with payment fees, fixed at deployment.

getSplit(uint256).notice: Read a split's current configuration; unknown IDs revert.

pay(uint256,uint256,uint32,bytes32).notice: Pull approved USDC from the payer and credit fees and recipients.

splitCount().notice: Number of splits created. Split IDs start at 1 and are never reused.

updateSplit(uint256,address[],uint16[]).notice: Change only future payment allocations; accrued balances are untouched.

usdc().notice: The payment token, fixed at deployment.

withdraw(address).notice: Withdraw the caller's full accrued balance to a chosen address.
